title: Returned-Payment-Fee Relief on PracticePay Plans: Personal Loans Share
content:
**Rule.** The personal-loan share of a PracticePay Patient Financing returned-payment-fee relief reads every Larkspur personal loan the customer has held: a late fee posted on any of them within the last 12 months gives 0.8; a returned payment but no late fee posted on any of them within the last 12 months gives 0.9; otherwise the share is 1; a window of the last N months here covering entries dated fewer than N whole months before the relief date, a month being whole once the relief date's day of the month has reached the entry's day of the month.

Records read: the late-fee and returned-payment entries on all of the customer's Personal Loans, open or closed.

| Personal Loans record, last 12 months | Share |
|---|---|
| any late fee | 0.8 |
| a returned payment and no late fee | 0.9 |
| no late fee and no returned payment | 1 |

*Hypothetical.* A customer with two personal loans: one paid off with a late fee 9 months ago, one open with a clean record. The late fee on the paid-off loan counts: 0.8.
